title: Battery Replacement Warranties: Schedule of Coverage Periods
content:
Under the Battery Replacement Warranties every period runs in months from the purchase date on the original ticket. The free period is the span during which a failed battery is replaced free; the prorated period runs from the purchase date through the stated month and is the span through which a failed battery earns a prorated credit after the free period. Where a line has no proration, its prorated figure equals its free figure. A separate pair of figures applies when the vehicle is in commercial use, replacing the personal-use pair.

## Schedule

| Line | Free period, personal use (months) | Prorated through, personal use (months) | Free period, commercial use (months) | Prorated through, commercial use (months) | Free replacements allowed during the free period |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Standard 24-Month Battery | 24 | 24 | 6 | 6 | 1 |
| Crestline Plus 30-Month Battery | 30 | 60 | 9 | 18 | 1 |
| Crestline Gold 36-Month Battery | 36 | 72 | 12 | 24 | 1 |
| Crestline AGM 36-Month Battery | 36 | 72 | 12 | 24 | 2 |
| Crestline Platinum AGM 48-Month Battery | 48 | 84 | 18 | 30 | 2 |
| Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 | 1 |

## Notes to the schedule

- The commercial-use figures take the place of the personal-use figures of the same line.
- The Crestline Standard 24-Month Battery and the Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery have equal free and prorated figures, so neither line has a span of prorated cover after its free period.
- The Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery has the same figures for personal and commercial use.
- The last column is the number of free replacements one warranty allows during its free period: two for the two AGM lines, one for every other line.

## Reading the schedule by line (personal use)

| Line | Months of free cover | Months of prorated cover after the free period |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Standard 24-Month Battery | 24 | none |
| Crestline Plus 30-Month Battery | 30 | 30 (from the end of month 30 through month 60) |
| Crestline Gold 36-Month Battery | 36 | 36 (from the end of month 36 through month 72) |
| Crestline AGM 36-Month Battery | 36 | 36 (from the end of month 36 through month 72) |
| Crestline Platinum AGM 48-Month Battery | 48 | 36 (from the end of month 48 through month 84) |
| Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery | 18 | none |
